import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    b = int(next(it))
    array = [int(next(it)) for _ in range(n)]
    cost = [-1] * n
    
    co = 0
    ce = 0
    cut = 0
    coin = 0
    
    for i in range(n):
        if array[i] % 2 == 0:
            ce += 1
        else:
            co += 1
        if co == ce and i != n - 1:
            cost[i] = abs(array[i+1] - array[i])
            co = 0
            ce = 0
    
    cost.sort()
    total = 0
    for val in cost:
        if val != -1:
            total += val
            if total > b:
                break
            cut += 1
    
    print(cut)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
